set.body: From the S10.1b review fixes (p0-s101 ba181a69). No UI control adds a panel to a figure, so the golden journey's A–E figure is still built by dispatching CreateFigure directly (a named bypass). Add the control, bound to a studio-app intent with headless tests, then convert the bypass in GoldenJourneyFxSuite.
set.title: Figures: a control to add a panel (AddPanel)
